court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Shri Sachin S/O Rameshrao Wankhade vs Sau Yogita W/O Sachin Wankhade And ... on 29 July, 2022
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

legal_principles.principle: Unless a party alleges and proves an act of domestic violence, she is not entitled for any relief as provided under the D.V. Act.
legal_principles.held: The respondent heavily relied on the decision of this Court in case of Koushik S/o Anil Gharami Vs. Sau. Sangeeta Koushik Gharami and others, 2014 ALL MR (Cri) 2398 , wherein it is held that the monetary relief can be granted under the D.V. Act provided there is a domestic violence.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act — Section X
cited_cases: Koushik S/o Anil Gharami Vs. Sau. Sangeeta Koushik Gharami and others, 2014 ALL MR (Cri) 2398

legal_principles.principle: The provisions under the D.V. Act cannot be invoked unless a party alleges an act of domestic violence and approaches to the Court in the capacity of the aggrieved person.
legal_principles.held: On the same line, reliance is placed on the decision of this Court in case of Prakash Kumar Singhee Vs. Amrapali Singhee, 2018(5) Mh.L.J. 665 , in which this Court has reiterated the position that the provisions under the D.V. Act cannot be invoked unless a party alleges an act of domestic violence and approach to the Court in the capacity of the aggrieved person.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act — Section X
cited_cases: Prakash Kumar Singhee Vs. Amrapali Singhee, 2018(5) Mh.L.J. 665
